13:
SELECT *
            FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT "sch"."phone"
                FROM "ranked" "r"
JOIN "schools" "sch" ON "sch"."cdscode" = "r"."cds"
WHERE "r"."rnk" <= 3
            ) sub
            ORDER BY "sch"."phone" ;
325:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m."molecule_id") AS "carcinogenic_nitrogen_molecules"
FROM "molecule" m
INNER JOIN "atom" a ON m."molecule_id" = a."molecule_id"
WHERE a."element" = 'n'
  AND m."label" = '+';
279:
SELECT DISTINCT m."label"
FROM "bond" b
JOIN "molecule" m ON b."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
WHERE b."bond_id" = 'TR001_10_11';
276:
SELECT c."atom_id" AS "first_atom", c."atom_id2" AS "second_atom"
FROM "bond" b
JOIN "connected" c ON b."bond_id" = c."bond_id"
WHERE b."bond_type" = '#'
498:
SELECT DISTINCT st."translation"
FROM "foreign_data" fd
JOIN "cards" c ON fd."uuid" = c."uuid"
JOIN "set_translations" st ON c."setcode" = st."setcode"
WHERE fd."language" = 'French'
  AND fd."name" = 'Tendo Ice Bridge'
  AND st."language" = 'French';
417:
SELECT 
    (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "s"."type" = 'expansion' THEN "s"."id" END) * 100.0) / COUNT(DISTINCT "s"."id") AS "percentage"
FROM "sets" "s"
JOIN "set_translations" "st" ON "s"."code" = "st"."setcode"
WHERE "st"."language" = 'Japanese';
345:
SELECT DISTINCT l.status
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.types = 'Artifact'
  AND c.side IS NULL
  AND l.format = 'vintage';
1480:
SELECT 
    SUBSTRING(ym."date", 5, 2) AS "month",
    SUM(ym."consumption") AS "total_consumption"
FROM "yearmonth" ym
JOIN "customers" c ON ym."customerid" = c."customerid"
WHERE 
    c."segment" = 'SME'
    AND ym."date" BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
GROUP BY SUBSTRING(ym."date", 5, 2)
ORDER BY "total_consumption" DESC
LIMIT 1;
1529:
SELECT 
    SUM(t."amount" * t."price") AS "total_spent_all",
    SUM(CASE WHEN to_char(t."date", 'YYYYMM') = '201201' THEN t."amount" * t."price" ELSE 0 END) AS "total_spent_jan2012"
FROM "transactions_1k" t
WHERE t."customerid" = 38508;
1388:
SELECT DISTINCT "m"."first_name" || ' ' || "m"."last_name" AS "full_name", "i"."source"
FROM "income" "i"
JOIN "member" "m" ON "i"."link_to_member" = "m"."member_id"
WHERE "i"."amount" = (SELECT MAX("amount") FROM "income");
1359:
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN e."event_name" LIKE '%Yearly Kickoff%' THEN b."amount" ELSE 0 END)::numeric 
    / 
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN e."event_name" LIKE '%October Meeting%' THEN b."amount" ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 0) AS "times_more"
FROM "budget" b
JOIN "event" e ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
WHERE b."category" = 'Advertisement';
1429:
SELECT DISTINCT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.type = 'Social'
  AND e.location = '900 E. Washington St.'
  AND m.position LIKE '%Vice President%';
